bugs.error_message: Backlinks for character-to-location, character-to-species, character-to-occupation, character-to-skill relationships silently return empty arrays
bugs.root_cause: backlinkUtils.ts references field names that don't exist on the actual entity types: `placeOfResidenceId` (actual: `pairedCurrentLocationNew`), `placeOfOriginId` (actual: `pairedOriginLocationNew`), `placeOfDemiseId` (actual: `pairedDemiseLocationNew`), `speciesIds` (actual: `pairedRace`), `occupationIds` (actual: `pairedProfession`), `skillIds` (actual: `pairedSkills`), etc. Also `parentsOfCharacter` / `childOfCharacter` were ignored.
bugs.fix: Updated backlinkUtils.ts to scan both modern `paired*` and relationship arrays as well as legacy fields. Also synced `allies` alias and group affiliations.

bugs.error_message: DashboardView creative insights re-randomize on every re-render, causing unstable/flickering text
bugs.root_cause: `insights` is computed inside a `useMemo` that depends on `world.entities` and `world.trash`, but calls `Math.random()` internally. Any state change that updates these (e.g., adding a tag) re-rolls all insight text. The memo does not capture a stable random seed.
bugs.fix: Either (a) seed the random selection with a stable value (e.g., a hash of entity IDs), or (b) move the random picks outside the memo and stabilize them with a separate `useState` that only updates when `world.entities.length` changes.

bugs.error_message: NexusTreeView silently truncates family trees deeper than 5 levels with no user feedback
bugs.root_cause: TreeNode component has a guard `depth < 5` that stops rendering children beyond depth 5. No UI indicator was shown when truncation occurred.
bugs.fix: Added visual truncation indicator badge `+N descendants (depth limit)` when depth >= 5. Also updated root & child discovery to check bidirectional parent/child relations and fixed isDead check.

bugs.error_message: WorldMap location marker and connection creation uses window.prompt() — inaccessible and blocked in some browsers
bugs.root_cause: Adding a location marker calls `prompt('Location Anchor Name:')` and adding a connection calls `prompt('Connection Type (trade, magic, diplomatic, war):', 'trade')`. window.prompt() is synchronous, blocks the UI, is inaccessible to screen readers, and is suppressed in iframes/embedded environments.
bugs.fix: Replace prompt() calls with an inline modal or popover UI. A simple React state-driven modal with a text input would be both accessible and unblockable.

bugs.error_message: Timeline characters missing from view when dateOfBirth / dateOfDeath fields are empty strings
bugs.root_cause: TimelineView reads `char.dateOfBirth` and `char.dateOfDeath`, but the actual Character type uses `birthDate` and `deathDate`. Also Event type uses `startDate` / `endDate` instead of `date`.
bugs.fix: Updated TimelineView.tsx to read `char.birthDate || char.dateOfBirth`, `char.deathDate || char.dateOfDeath`, and `evt.startDate || evt.date`.

bugs.error_message: git push pending — local main is 1 commit ahead of origin/main
bugs.root_cause: Phase 0 cleanup commit (a42247f) was created locally but not pushed to GitHub. The remote repo is behind.
bugs.fix: Run `git push` from the project root to publish the Phase 0 cleanup commit.
